description: Reconstructs a physical two-qubit density matrix from a complete background-corrected H/V/D/A/R/L coincidence observation. It preserves the unconstrained linear-inversion estimate as a diagnostic and fits a positive semidefinite trace-one matrix by maximum likelihood. The result is a reconstructed state, not a fidelity metric: downstream protocols may compare it with a target state or derive quality estimates without repeating tomography.
summary: Reconstruct a physical two-qubit density matrix from complete corrected tomography.

entangledPairPolarizationTomography.description: Complete output object from MeasureEntangledPairPolarizationCoincidences. Its correctedCountsByProjection member must contain every logical H/V/D/A/R/L pair projection with finite non-negative counts. Projection keys are two-state strings (HH, HV, ... LL); null or missing counts are invalid. Existing count normalization and reconstruction validation are reused.

maxIterations.description: Maximum L-BFGS-B iterations for the physical maximum-likelihood fit. The default preserves the historical reconstruction limit.

tomography.state.estimate.twoQubitDensit.description: Physical maximum-likelihood two-qubit density-matrix estimate with its linear-inversion diagnostic, basis probabilities, Bloch vectors, correlations, optimizer metadata, and source-observation provenance.

tomography.state.status.reconstruction.description: Reconstruction completion state. A solver non-convergence is published as WARNING with its best physical estimate, preserving the historical behavior.

tomography.state.artifact.twoQubitDensit.description: Path to the JSON report for the reconstructed density matrix.
